title: CuraLight: Debate-Guided Data Curation for LLM-Centered Traffic Signal Control

claim.summary: CuraLight uses an RL traffic assistant and multi-LLM deliberation to curate phase-duration decisions, then adapts a Gemma language model using priority-aware LoRA imitation.

modules.name: Priority-aware traffic-controller adaptation
modules.scope_reason: Updates the language model adapters on intersection-state reasoning and phase-duration responses.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "Priority Aware LoRA Imitation Fine Tuning:"

modules.name: RL-filtered traffic-action debate and data selection
modules.scope_reason: Candidate selection, arguments and priorities are tied to queues, congestion and signal-control outcomes.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "RL based pre-filtering."
